data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-m-r', meaning 'to distribute'. Dameera is a name for a virtuous woman who shares her blessings and resources with others. The name Dameera carries the meaning “Virtuous, one who distributes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dameera usually hope their child will grow to embody virtuous, one who distributes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
